target.statement: AACP reduces 50% FLOPs of VGG16 on CIFAR10 with +0.16% top-1 accuracy (Ours (S,0.50): 93.72% vs baseline 93.56%)

compute.basis: No code released; must reimplement AACP (IDE search + PSAE) and train VGG16 on CIFAR10 for 160 epochs plus 320-epoch from-scratch training of the pruned model, which is many CPU-hours even on a small dataset.

blockers: No code released (paper says source code will be released after publication)
Requires reimplementing IDE search and PSAE from scratch
Training VGG16 on CIFAR10 for 160+320 epochs is slow on CPU-only laptop
title: AACP: Model Compression by Accurate and Automatic Channel Pruning
